caption:
I used to start the gift season in a panic. Now I start with three prompts. ☕

One for the list and budget, one for ideas that aren't just more stuff, and one for a timeline so nothing lands in the last week. Any AI assistant you already use will do.

Save this for your gift list, and tell me: are you an early or a last-minute gifter?

#aiprompts #aitools #giftideas #holidayplanning #productivity #womeninbusiness

✦ AI-generated creator

slides.title: 3 AI prompts for a calmer gift season

slides.heading: The list
slides.body: “Help me list everyone I want to give something to this year, with a budget per person that adds up to my total.”

slides.heading: The ideas
slides.body: “Here are three things she loves. Give me five gift ideas under my budget that aren't just more stuff.”

slides.heading: The timeline
slides.body: “Turn my list into a small weekly plan until mid-December, so nothing is left for the last few days.”

slides.quote: Thoughtful doesn't have to mean frantic.
slides.author: Arielle
